title: What does the AICR Operator do?

scenes.heading: Who coordinates the next change?
voice: Your GPU stack is running, and the platform team needs a controlled change.
In preview, the AICR Operator reads the intended configuration from a ClusterRuntime object.

scenes.heading: Get a rollout plan
scenes.sub: A pinned AICR release generates it
voice: The Operator invokes a pinned AICR release to discover the cluster, resolve a recipe, and generate its bundle.
The candidate rollout plan records what the Operator intends to change.

scenes.heading: Wait for ready, then continue
scenes.sub: Argo CD applies each planned release
voice: After any required approval, Argo CD applies the releases.
The Operator advances them in dependency order, using readiness at the revision it just requested before moving to the next step.

scenes.heading: Verify the deployed plan
scenes.sub: Tie deployment results to the rollout
voice: With deployment validation enabled, AICR checks the running stack and ties evidence to the plan.
The preview uses Argo CD and one accelerator and operating system profile per cluster.

payoff: Trace ClusterRuntime intent through a pinned AICR release, an ordered Argo CD rollout, and deployment evidence.
